The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2399192~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 设置秒级监控数仓信息，如果当前地域存在已开启秒级监控的监听，需要先关闭才可以调整秒级监控数仓。
descriptions.en: This operation is used to configure a data warehouse for the fine-grained monitoring feature. If a listener in the current region has fine-grained monitoring enabled, you must disable fine-grained monitoring before you can configure a warehouse.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nlb set-hd-monitor-region-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project hdmonitor-cn-hangzhou-223794579283657556 --metric-store hdmonitor-cn-hangzhou-metricStore-1 --region cn-hangzhou
